dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Ugh... Agafya, I'm fine... It's just a little stomachache..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Alright. Well, I found four apples... you can have them when you're feeling a little better..."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Don't worry about that, Zakhar. I'll take care of it... you just head up there and get a good rest."
